releaseNotes: V976 fixes one AI Grounding false positive observed in the V975 video test without weakening the V974 semantic guard.

An explicit NOT_EVALUATED explanation tied to absent explicit condition criteria is now treated as an epistemic limitation when normal/abnormal terms are used only to explain that classification was not performed.

Unsupported positive condition claims such as healthy/normal state, high/low value, safe/risky state, baseline deviation without a valid learned baseline, and unsupported missing-data inference remain blocked.

V975 operator-clarity UI, deterministic Operational/Condition evaluation, AI Data Library, Safe Disconnect, communication, Polling/MAX, PDO/ISDU, Studio Runtime, HMI read-only, and Signal Tower hardware-control paths are unchanged.

en: Fixed a Grounding false positive for explicit NOT_EVALUATED / no-criteria explanations.
Normal/abnormal wording is allowed only when used to state that classification was not performed.
Positive health, magnitude, risk, baseline-deviation, and unsupported missing-data claims remain blocked.
No change to deterministic evaluation or protected runtime/control paths.
ko: 명시적인 NOT_EVALUATED / No Criteria 설명이 Grounding에서 잘못 차단되던 false positive를 수정했습니다.
정상/비정상 표현은 판정을 수행하지 않았다는 비판정 설명에 한해 허용됩니다.
Health, 높음/낮음, 위험/안전, Baseline deviation, 근거 없는 데이터 누락 추론에 대한 차단은 그대로 유지됩니다.
결정론적 평가와 보호된 Runtime/제어 경로는 변경하지 않았습니다.
ja: 明示的な NOT_EVALUATED / No Criteria 説明が Grounding で誤って遮断される false positive を修正しました。
Normal/Abnormal の表現は、判定を実施していないことを説明する場合に限って許可されます。
Health、高低、Risk、Baseline deviation、根拠のない欠損データ推論の遮断は維持されます。
決定論的評価および保護された Runtime/制御経路は変更していません。
zh-CN: 修复了明确 NOT_EVALUATED / No Criteria 说明被 Grounding 错误拦截的 false positive。
Normal/Abnormal 表述仅在说明未执行状态分类时允许。
Health、高低、Risk、Baseline deviation 以及无依据的数据缺失推断仍会被拦截。
未修改确定性评估及受保护的 Runtime/控制路径。
de: Ein Grounding-False-Positive bei expliziten NOT_EVALUATED-/No-Criteria-Erklärungen wurde behoben.
Normal/Abnormal-Formulierungen sind nur zulässig, wenn ausdrücklich erklärt wird, dass keine Klassifikation durchgeführt wurde.
Positive Health-, High/Low-, Risk-, Baseline-Deviation- und unbelegte Missing-Data-Aussagen bleiben blockiert.
Deterministische Bewertung und geschützte Runtime-/Steuerpfade wurden nicht geändert.
es: Se corrigió un falso positivo de Grounding para explicaciones explícitas NOT_EVALUATED / No Criteria.
Las expresiones Normal/Abnormal solo se permiten cuando explican que no se realizó una clasificación.
Las afirmaciones positivas de Health, High/Low, Risk, Baseline deviation y Missing Data sin evidencia siguen bloqueadas.
No se modificaron la evaluación determinista ni las rutas protegidas de Runtime/control.
